_src: how each block was measured is in its own _src. measure.py: the released Allie 2.1, PyTorch reference, on one September 2026 Lichess game and samples of that month, after all of its training data. The game and the attention heads ran on a CPU in int8, the expert scan and the lesions on a GPU in BF16, as Allie.from_pretrained loads each

game._src: Lichess open database, September 2026, rated blitz (heldout-2026-09/store, games/b32009/shard-0000.parquet); game WlgHwHZ1; no player names are shown

plies_src: measure.py game: Model.forward reference, legal moves renormalized as Allie.analyze does; think expect from the 63 think bins and CENTRES

focus._src: measure.py game: rating sweep changes only the mover's four header digits; clock sweep only the mover's time left at the last token

swing._src: measure.py pick: total variation between the move distributions at both ratings 1000 and both 2500; blitz and 10-minute games, ratings 1300-2300, 50-120 plies; the position was hand-picked from this list

parts._src: the focus token's real vectors in the released weights, every 4th of the 2,048 numbers: Model.board, Model.clock and the embed table (game.npz)

route._src: router choices of the released weights on this game, all 21 routed blocks, per position (game.npz, measure.py game); blocks count from 1 as in DETAILS (1-24), experts and heads from 0

attention._src: attention weights of the released weights: this game for the shown heat (game.npz); shares from measure.py heads, positions from ply 4 on, over all 24 blocks and 32 heads. even_rating, even_header: the same shares if every head spread its attention evenly over the tokens it can see. head_top_*: each head's largest share among six groups (the mover's rating, the other's, the time control, the token itself, the mover's last move, the start token), on the same 40 games the shown heads were picked on. xsa_*: tanh of the weights' xsa table, the amount of its projection on the token's own value each head subtracts: 1 removes it all, below 0 adds to it. A last-8-plies mask limits direct attention only: older moves still flow through the tokens in between; a true re-read of the header and last 8 plies cost +0.055 [0.033, 0.081] against the mask's +0.030 on 25 games, in a separate audit (release-2.1/explainers/review/audit.Usie/recheck.py)

examples.label: the rating of the player to move, 68% on its tens digit

lesion._src: measure.py lesion: the released weights with one part changed after training, paired on the same positions; CE over legal moves in nats, on a natural mix of a random sample of September 2026 games, so higher than the main test set's plain mean of 16 cells; intervals over games
lesion.check: cross-check through the public Allie.analyze on the CPU (int8, Rust engine), first 1,076 positions of a separate sample of 40 games: loss 1.2887 real, +0.0077 clocks hidden, +0.0316 both ratings at 1626
lesion.best_k: lesion_mlp keeps the router's top k by selection score with their original weights, not rescaled to sum to 4

ratings_by_mover._src: measure.py ratings: both ratings at the median, the lesion's games and case again, cut by the mover's rating; distance: mean points from the median

recapture._src: measure.py recapture: the clock sweep on contested recaptures, so the shown position's rise and fall back can be compared with its like; rise_10s: 10 s against 180 s; drop_2s: 2 s against 10 s, negative for a drop; intervals over positions, about one a game

scan._src: measure.py scan: the released weights, PyTorch reference, on 12,000 games of September 2026, 827,003 positions; each shown expert has the top F1 score for its feature on one random half of the games, every rate here is measured on the other half; precision: the share of its runs on target; firing rates count the positions predicting a move, not the header; rank: sort of block 8's experts by their mean ply on the first half

detectors.runs: of its runs are in check

detectors.of: of positions with a Black pawn on g4
detectors.runs: of its runs have it on g4; most others, on g3

cards.what: 4 or fewer pieces on the board
